name: openbb_etf_equity_exposure
description:
ETFs that hold a given stock, with weight and market value, through the OpenBB Platform (obb.etf.equity_exposure).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (stock ticker); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp only; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
The reverse (what one ETF holds): openbb_etf_holdings; another source: fmp_etf_stock_exposure. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "NVDA", "provider": "fmp"}
